On the Prodigall

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

T
ELL
 me, bright boy, tell me, my golden lad,
Whither away so frolick? why so glad?
What all thy wealth in Counsile? all thy state?
Are husks so deare, troth ’tis a mighty rate.
